steps.title: Prepare Slides and Controls
steps.instruction: Select paraffin slides for IF staining and ensure secondary-only negative controls are included.

steps.title: Dry Slides
steps.instruction: Place slides in a glass slide box and incubate at 60 °C for 25 minutes in a dry incubator.

steps.title: Rehydrate Sections
steps.instruction: Rehydrate slides using a series of solutions poured slowly into a glass slide box from 50mL conical tubes.

substeps.instruction: HistoClear: 2 x 10 minutes
100% EtOH: 2 x 5 minutes
90% EtOH (45 mL pure EtOH + 5 mL DI water): 3 minutes
80% EtOH (40 mL pure EtOH + 10 mL DI water): 3 minutes
70% EtOH (35 mL pure EtOH + 15 mL DI water): 3 minutes
50% EtOH (25 mL pure EtOH + 25 mL DI water): 3 minutes

steps.title: Initial Wash
steps.instruction: Wash slides in tap water 3 times for 5 minutes each.

steps.title: Antigen Retrieval
steps.instruction: Perform antigen retrieval using one of the specified buffers (1 mM EDTA pH 8.0, Tris-EDTA pH 9.0, Sodium Citrate pH 6.0, or Antigen Retrieval Reagent).

substeps.instruction: Transfer slides to a plastic slide box and fill to the line with the chosen retrieval buffer.
Add DI-water to a pressure cooker up to the metal plate.
Use the 'porridge' option (20 minutes); remove after 45 minutes (display should read 'LO -25').
Move slides to sit at room temperature in the plastic box with retrieval buffer to cool slowly (minimum 30 minutes, up to 2 hours) until the box is cool to the touch.

steps.title: Post-Retrieval Wash
steps.instruction: Wash slides in PBST/TBST 3 times for 3 minutes each.

steps.title: Permeabilization
steps.instruction: Permeabilize the nuclear membrane using 0.25% Triton X-100 in PBS for 5 to 10 minutes.

steps.title: Slide Preparation for Staining
steps.instruction: Prepare slides for subsequent liquid applications.

substeps.instruction: Wipe away water and circle the section with a slide pen.
Re-add 200 µL of tap water per slide.
Transfer slides to a black hydration box.
Use a cut P-200 pipette tip for all future steps to prevent high pressure (standard volume 200 µL unless noted), aspirating with vacuum.

steps.title: Secondary Wash
steps.instruction: Rinse slides with tap water 2 times for 5 minutes each.

steps.title: Blocking
steps.instruction: Incubate slides with blocking buffer (5% BSA in TBST) in a hydration chamber for 30 to 60 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Primary Antibody Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate slides with primary antibody (typically 1:400) diluted in blocking buffer overnight at 4 °C in a hydration chamber.

substeps.instruction: Add tap water to the wells between slides in the chamber to prevent evaporation.

steps.title: Secondary Antibody Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate slides with secondary antibody (typically 1:500, or 1:1000 for GFP/488) diluted in 1x PBS/blocking buffer (3% BSA in TBST) at room temperature for 1 hour (minimum 30 minutes) in a hydration chamber in the dark.

substeps.instruction: Turn off lab lights when applying the secondary antibody.

steps.title: Post-Secondary Wash
steps.instruction: Wash slides in PBST/TBST 3 times for 3 minutes each.

steps.title: DAPI Staining
steps.instruction: Incubate slides with 1x DAPI (diluted 1:1000 in ddH2O) at room temperature for 15 minutes in a hydration chamber.

steps.title: Final Wash
steps.instruction: Wash slides in PBST/TBST 3 times for 3 minutes each.

steps.title: Mounting and Storage
steps.instruction: Mount the sections and seal the slides.

substeps.instruction: Add 10-15 µL of anti-fade mounting medium to each section.
Apply cover slip, press with a plastic pipette tip to remove bubbles, and blot clean with a paper towel.
Store in the dark at room temperature for at least 15 minutes, then move to a DRY slide box at 4 °C overnight.
Trace the edge of the slide cover with clear nail polish and return to a 4 °C DRY slide box for long-term storage.
